channel.title: GNUS digest
channel.description: Daily digest of the GeniusVentures GitHub activity, written from public commit messages.

item.title: GNUS digest — Saturday 14 November
item.description: A new roadmap and requirement list for the upcoming version were documented, and the backup system was updated to support a tiered storage model. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Friday 13 November
item.description: An outdated AI component was removed and its documentation cleaned up, while the network's backup system received enhancements and storage cleanup processes were improved. Repositories: GeniusCognitiveSystem, GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, GNUS-NEO-SWARM, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Thursday 12 November
item.description: New investment scenario calculations and related fixes were added to the dashboards, and a feature to retrieve payout addresses was introduced in the developer toolkit, along with several improvements and new input components. Repositories: gnus-investor-scenarios, GeniusSDK, thirdparty, openapi-client-scaffold, GeniusWallet, SuperGenius, libp2p, openapi-cpp-scaffolding.

item.title: GNUS digest — Wednesday 11 November
item.description: The network milestone was successfully audited and documentation was cleaned up, the wallet now reports more accurate earnings information, and a new way to get payout addresses was added to the system. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, GeniusWallet, SuperGenius, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, GeniusSDK, CIDocker.

item.title: GNUS digest — Tuesday 10 November
item.description: Security improvements were added, including rotating refresh tokens and password hashing, and the dashboard received visual design and accessibility fixes. Repositories: openapi-cpp-scaffolding, SuperGenius, GeniusNetwork, gnus-dashboard.

item.title: GNUS digest — Monday 9 November
item.description: Password handling was secured by hashing and email indexing was added, with tests confirming the changes. Repositories: openapi-cpp-scaffolding.
